# Arcan Painting

> Arcan Painting accepts inquiries about interior, exterior, and commercial painting, wallpaper services, and specialty finishes. Project scope and availability are confirmed directly with the team.

## Services
- [Interior painting](https://arcanpainting.ca/interior-painting)
- [Exterior painting](https://arcanpainting.ca/exterior-painting)
- [Commercial painting](https://arcanpainting.ca/commercial-painting)
- [Wallpaper services](https://arcanpainting.ca/wallpaper-services)
- [Specialty finishes](https://arcanpainting.ca/specialty-finishes)

Contact Arcan Painting to discuss availability for your project location.
